page.layout: Printed page 25 on the right side of the scan: running head at top; two marginal note lines at the top left of the text block (numbered 13 and 14) as a full-width list beside the text; main text in one column with a centred section heading "SECT. I."; a signature word "Paulus" at the lower right of the text. Left margin fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.l: 13. Hypoth. 5. Rei illicitæ nulla Obligatio.
14. Juramenti illiciti, & Juramenti de re ill-
SECT. I.
EXposito superiore lectione quid Jura-
mentum in genere, quid in specie prom-
issorium Juramentum, & quid Obligatio: per-
gendum nunc porro ad proponendum, quod
proxime pollicitus sum, quasdam τετάρτας five
Hypotheses instituto nostro accommodas, ve-
lut fundamenta, aut (si malitis) Canones &
κανόνες totius futuræ disquisitionis: e quibus
sc. petendæ sunt, & ad quas exigendæ,
pleroramque dubiorum determinationes.
Sed unum vos interim, antiquam id faci-
am, non jam exoratum eo, (quod facerem
si aut suspecta mihi esset vestra huma-
nitas, aut res ipsa non esset multo justissi-
ma:) sed præmonitos tantum velim;
mihi constitutum esse, dum reperiam quod
rei de qua agitur utcunque significandæ
sufficiat, de verbis non ultra laborare, mul-
to minus de sermonis puritate, nedum ele-
gantia sollicitum esse. Curent ista scilicet,
quibus vacat, & cordi est, negotium
faccessere sibi non necessarium. Repetere
soleo cum amicis non sine aliquo risuque jo-
coque, quantum sudarit, ut tandem incipiret
magis, vir alias sane non ineruditus,
Paulus

page.notes: Marginal note letters at the top left are cut off by the edge of the scan. The Greek words in the text ("τετάρτας" and "κανόνες") are a poor reading of a few badly printed Greek characters and may be inexact. The left-margin fragments (ofui, ijus, ro-, re-, ti-) belong to the neighbouring page.
